de: French and Spanish forces begin the assault against British forces occupying Diamond Rock, Martinique.

t: 法国大革命：革命法庭被镇压。
te: The Revolutionary Tribunal is suppressed.
dz: 法国大革命：革命法庭被镇压。
de: French Revolution: The Revolutionary Tribunal is suppressed.

t: 美国颁布了第一部版权法规"1790年版权法".
te: The United States enacts its first copyright statute, the Copyright Act of 1790.
dz: 美国颁布了第一部版权法规"1790年版权法".
de: The United States enacts its first copyright statute, the Copyright Act of 1790.

t: 曼努埃尔·昆佩尔探索了胡安·德富卡海峡.
te: Manuel Quimper explores the Strait of Juan de Fuca.
dz: 曼努埃尔·昆佩尔探索了胡安·德富卡海峡.
de: Manuel Quimper explores the Strait of Juan de Fuca.

t: 梅克伦堡决议被北卡罗来纳省采纳.
te: The Mecklenburg Resolves are adopted in the Province of North Carolina.
dz: 美国革命:梅克伦堡决议被北卡罗来纳省采纳.
de: American Revolution: The Mecklenburg Resolves are adopted in the Province of North Carolina.

t: 以视力不佳为理由,塞缪尔·佩皮斯在他的日记中记录了最后的事件.
te: Citing poor eyesight as a reason, Samuel Pepys records the last event in his diary.
dz: 以视力不佳为理由,塞缪尔·佩皮斯在他的日记中记录了最后的事件.
de: Citing poor eyesight as a reason, Samuel Pepys records the last event in his diary.

t: 选美会"伦敦对泰晤士河畔亨利王子的爱"(London's Love to Prince Hen…
te: The pageant London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames celebrates the creation of Prince Henry as Prince of Wale…
dz: 选美会"伦敦对泰晤士河畔亨利王子的爱"(London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames)庆祝亨利王子被创立为"威尔士王子".
de: The pageant London's Love to Prince Henry on the River Thames celebrates the creation of Prince Henry as Prince of Wales.

t: 亨利三世国王所铺设的第一块石碑为"新桥"(Pont Neuf (New Bridge)),是法…
te: King Henry III lays the first stone of the Pont Neuf (New Bridge), the oldest bridge of Paris, France.
dz: 亨利三世国王所铺设的第一块石碑为"新桥"(Pont Neuf (New Bridge)),是法国巴黎最古老的桥梁.
de: King Henry III lays the first stone of the Pont Neuf (New Bridge), the oldest bridge of Paris, France.

t: 蒙古人出走爪哇后,蒙古人对辛格萨里国王克塔内加拉的入侵失败.
te: Mongols depart Java after the failed Mongol invasion against King Kertanegara of Singhasari.
dz: 蒙古人出走爪哇后,蒙古人对辛格萨里国王克塔内加拉的入侵失败.
de: Mongols depart Java after the failed Mongol invasion against King Kertanegara of Singhasari.

t: 喀尔喀河战役:由苏布泰所率领的成吉思汗蒙古军队击败了基辅鲁斯和库曼斯.
te: Battle of the Kalka River: Mongol armies of Genghis Khan led by Subutai defeat Kievan Rus' and Cumans.
dz: 蒙古人入侵库曼人:喀尔喀河战役:由苏布泰所率领的成吉思汗蒙古军队击败了基辅鲁斯和库曼斯.
de: Mongol invasion of the Cumans: Battle of the Kalka River: Mongol armies of Genghis Khan led by Subutai defeat Kievan Rus' and Cumans.

t: 当时在女真统治者金宣宗统治下的中都（今北京）被成吉思汗领导下的蒙古人占领，结束了中都之战。
te: Zhongdu (now Beijing), then under the control of the Jurchen ruler Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, is captured by the Mongols …
dz: 当时在女真统治者金宣宗统治下的中都（今北京）被成吉思汗领导下的蒙古人占领，结束了中都之战。
de: Zhongdu (now Beijing), then under the control of the Jurchen ruler Emperor Xuanzong of Jin, is captured by the Mongols under Genghis Khan, ending the Battle of Zhongdu.

t: 皇帝佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在逃离罗马时被愤怒的暴徒用石头砸死.
te: Emperor Petronius Maximus is stoned to death by an angry mob while fleeing Rome.
dz: 皇帝佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯在逃离罗马时被愤怒的暴徒用石头砸死.
de: Emperor Petronius Maximus is stoned to death by an angry mob while fleeing Rome.
